Premise correction: Redis is not used or configured for caching. The cache layer is an in-memory `sync.Map` in `store/cache/cache.go`.

Actual mechanism: `store.New` creates `userCache` with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute` in `store/store.go`. User entries are written via `Set`, so their TTL is 10 minutes (`store/user.go`).
